name: @bit-physics/web-fdtd-optics
description: Stack-B WebGPU web build — 2D Yee FDTD optics: Maxwell's curl equations stepped live (TF/SF plane waves, CPML, dielectric/lossy/PEC/Drude/Kerr materials), an HDR uber-composite render stack (cool-warm field, domain coloring, isophase wavefronts, schlieren, photon tracers, bloom), and a verification-visible PROVE layer that re-runs the f64-anchored deploy gate PLUS analytic optics gates (Fresnel R=0.04, Bohren-Huffman cylinder Mie) on the visitor's GPU (Phase-6, first electromagnetics-family sim).
